title: Indian Confit Duck Leg
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish made with tender duck leg confit, originating from the culinary traditions of India. Serve with naan or rice for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Marinate the duck leg confit in a mixture of silky soy sauce, kissed garam masala, and a pinch of salt for at least 2 hours.
Heat the skillet oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the duck leg confit until browned on both sides.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook the duck leg confit for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, warm the naan bread in the oven for 5 minutes.
To serve, place a duck leg confit on each naan bread, then top with a spoonful of hanging spinach and a slice of cured lemon.
